facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's Deputy Governor says a contract was signed in November 2024 for a central bank biometric financial ID system, with testing planned on two commercial banks and two mobile money operators.

systems.owner: Bank of the Republic of Burundi

The document states nothing on e-procurement for Burundi.
The switch and regional links are described as under implementation, and no licensing by the central bank is stated.

facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's Deputy Governor says the civil register is not digitised and not based on biometrics.

facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's Deputy Governor says there is no biometric national ID but the process and its preparatory works are underway.

BDI.note: The deck says there is no trusted digitally verifiable ID, so nothing checks against a national ID.
The inclusion rates in the deck (27.84% banks and MFIs, 69.54% mobile wallets) name no survey.

facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's Deputy Governor says banks and licensed non-banks offer digital financial services, with mobile wallets at 69.54% financial inclusion and P2P the main use case.
